locations.text: You stand before the wooden gates of a small village. The morning chill still lingers, and the dust of the road clings to your boots. Ahead lies an unfamiliar place — full of promises and unease. The village appears peaceful, yet there is something tense in that calm, as if the locals have long been expecting something — or someone. You have just arrived, and every step forward may reveal more than just the street beyond the gate.
